lines: // Refunds on a shipped order: small ones approved at once, larger ones waiting for a manager (docs/refunds.md).
const refundsOf = (store, orderId) => store.list("refunds").filter((r) => r.orderId === orderId);
const leftOf = (store, order) => order.totalMinor - refundsOf(store, order.id).reduce((n, r) => n + r.amountMinor, 0);
const fits = (store, order, amount) => Number.isInteger(amount) && amount > 0 && amount <= leftOf(store, order);
return fits(store, order, input?.amountMinor) ? null : { error: "INVALID" };
const why = refused(store, getOrder(store, orderId), input);
const refund = { id: nextId(store), orderId, amountMinor: input.amountMinor, state: input.amountMinor <= AT_ONCE_MINOR ? "approved" : "pending" };
export function approveRefund(store, orderId, refundId, by) {
if (!getOrder(store, orderId) || !refund || refund.orderId !== orderId) return { error: "NOT_FOUND" };
test("a small refund is approved at once, and a large one waits for a manager's approval", (t) => {
t.after(() => rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }));
const id = handle(store, { method: "POST", path: "/orders", body: { lines: [{ qty: 1, unitMinor: 20000 }] } }).body.id;
assert.equal(handle(store, { method: "POST", path: `/orders/${id}/refunds`, body: { amountMinor: 1000, by: { role: "clerk" } } }).body.state, "approved");
const large = handle(store, { method: "POST", path: `/orders/${id}/refunds`, body: { amountMinor: 8000, by: { role: "clerk" } } }).body;
assert.equal(handle(store, { method: "POST", path: `/orders/${id}/refunds/${large.id}/approve`, body: { by: { role: "clerk" } } }).status, 403);
assert.equal(handle(store, { method: "POST", path: `/orders/${id}/refunds/${large.id}/approve`, body: { by: { role: "manager" } } }).body.state, "approved");
